def evolved_p100(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i,j] = popcount(i) + popcount(j)
    # Position-based only -> no collective needed.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    popcount = torch.zeros(N, device=x.device)
    n_bits = max(1, (N - 1).bit_length())
    for k in range(n_bits):
        bit = (idx // (2 ** k)) % 2
        popcount = popcount + bit
    ii = popcount.view(N, 1)
    jj = popcount.view(1, N)
    result = (ii + jj).expand(N, N).contiguous().to(x.dtype)
    return result
